title: Machines & Generators
note: Images are copied from game textures; machine and block images use a representative face. Crafting recipes may be overridden by modpacks. Machine crafting recipes describe how to build the machine, not its processing recipes.
scope: Processing machines, generators, industrial controllers, pumps, botanical automation and craftable multiblock components. Storage, transport, ritual blocks and hidden formed parts are covered separately.
